article.title: Which elements of pulmonary rehabilitation improve physical activity and sleep in COPD? A systematic review and component network meta-analysis.
article.authors: Orme MW, Manifield J, Latimer L
article.abstract: Physical activity (PA) predicts both mortality and morbidity. Pulmonary rehabilitation (PR) is known to improve exercise capacity and quality of life, but it's impact on PA remains unclear. Likewise, it is uncertain which components of PR elicit the greatest response.
